answer_1.quote: We develop CAMI, a counselor agent that integrates state inference, topic exploration, and strategy selection modules, all aligned with established psychotherapy skills.
answer_1.outputs: counseling dialogues in motivational interviewing style

answer_2.quote: We report the following behavior-counts: 1) Reflection Question Ratio (R/Q)... 2) Proportion of Open Questions (%OQ)... 3) Proportion of Complex Reflections (%CR)... 4) Proportion of MI-Consistent Responses (%MIC)... 5) Percent Therapist Talk Time (%TTT)

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4o with the prompt from previous work to provide scores for each generated session.
methods: Spearman correlation between expert and model annotations

answer_4.quote: We involve three co-authors (two with strong counseling credential and expertise and another is a social science student with rich experience in peer support and counseling) to assess the overall performance of CoS and CAMI.
answer_4.guideline: Each assessor is to rate the simulated counselor interacting with clients simulated by five client profiles randomly selected from AnnoMI such that both the high and low quality sessions for these clients exist in AnnoMI. The sessions are then evaluated by MITI Ratings, Change Talk Exploration, Success in Eliciting Change Talk, and Realism of both Counselor and Client.
